figures.title: Figure 4
figures.summary: Four parent zeta loading contexts (0/0.5/5/50 uM), two distinct inset liquids (5 uM-parent supernatant and DBS-LDH-only supernatant; excitation 230 nm), and separate 0.1 mM polarized-PL context. Parent loading is not residual concentration. Prose/plot magnitude conflict remains explicit; no exact zeta values digitized.

conflictPairs.context: Main p.4 prose describes zeta potential as increasing in magnitude when QD loading rises, whereas Figure 4a trends toward less-negative potentials: numerical potential increases but absolute magnitude decreases. This wording/plot inconsistency remains unresolved; no exact graph values are digitized or silently substituted.
conflictPairs.interpretation: Retained as source uncertainty; no silent resolution.

general_background.title: Thermodynamics and kinetics
general_background.summary: Thermodynamics describes which states are energetically favoured, while kinetics governs how quickly a system can move between them. A change can be favourable yet proceed slowly when an activation barrier or limited transport restricts the pathway.
general_background.label: General background, not the authors' interpretation
